---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What pain point does this solve? Which command or workflow is awkward today?

**Proposed solution**
What should skillsync do? A CLI sketch helps, e.g.:

```
skillsync <cmd> --flag ...
```

**Alternatives considered**
How do you work around this today?

**Additional context**
Which toolchains / skill layouts are involved (Codex, Claude, Qoder, WorkBuddy, custom roots)?
